title: EP60030: Entrepreneurship With Established Organizations
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Entrepreneurship with Established Organizations (EP 60030) Service strategies
followed by established industries, Major share of the market, examination and
evaluation of business practices and policies, Long term service markets where
potential for growth is expected, understanding scope of innovations within an
existing corporate structure and culture, stages of identification, initiation,
launch, management, new department or subsidiary creation, spin-off and spinout strategies, mergers and acquisitions, integrations and sustainable growth.
